evidence.text: Invert ψ = L_,Y, construct U = ψY-L, and integrate the auxiliary higher-derivative term by parts. Applied to the supplied square root, this operation reconstructs the homogeneous equations and stress-energy expressions. The general formulation is an agent abstraction.

sources.title: Bouncing universe with quintom matter

evidence.text: Introduce ψ = ∂L/∂(□φ), eliminate the higher derivative on a regular branch, and solve the coupled φ–ψ background system subject to the Friedmann constraint. Compute w only away from zero density and identify a bounce using H and Ḣ.
